scope: Read-only inspection of official upstream repositories for BlackYT Android PWA PoC; no upstream code copied into PoC.

acquisition.method: Read-only shallow checkouts of all three official repositories at their current branch HEADs; code inspected locally with exact line ranges and cross-checked against project docs.
acquisition.clone_status: completed after approved read-only network escalation; checkouts are under research/src/

evidence.finding: Supported YouTube frontend; documents background audio, queues, subscriptions, channel groups, and group feeds.
onCreate creates MediaSessionCompat and connector; onStartCommand handles service intents and playback controls. This is native Android service/session behavior.
getLoadedMediaSource resolves a stream's source, caches it with service-specific expiry, and emits failures for extraction/network errors.
makeConnection handles byte range requests, YouTube origin/referer and fetch headers, user-agent and request method. These native HTTP controls are not all available to browser JavaScript.
getAudioStreams, getVideoStreams and getVideoOnlyStreams call getItags over regular/adaptive formats and build direct stream objects after page extraction.
Stream descriptor has URL/content, video-only flag, resolution and format metadata.
Player JavaScript extraction dependency, illustrating maintenance burden when YouTube changes.
Defines Full Local Mode as connecting directly to YouTube; alternate mode routes requests through a chosen Piped instance; direct mode exposes requester IP to YouTube.

NewPipeMediaServiceRepository initializes the extractor's PoTokenProvider; getStreams calls StreamInfo.getInfo on a YouTube URL and maps metadata, audio/video stream objects, HLS/DASH and subtitles into app models.
Repository singleton getter currently constructs NewPipeMediaServiceRepository.
startPlayback fetches streams through the repository; setStreamSource configures direct audio/DASH/HLS media sources, then prepare/configurePlayer starts playback.
Native MediaLibraryService owns ExoPlayer/MediaLibrarySession, returns the session to controllers, creates the player/session, and installs the notification provider.
Room entity stores channel groups; SubscriptionsBottomSheet.kt:142-168 filters subscriptions by the selected group's channel IDs.

Full Local Mode is described as directly fetching everything from YouTube without Piped; privacy policy notes direct requests expose the device IP. At this observed HEAD, repository singleton points at NewPipeMediaServiceRepository.

pwa_assessment.metadata_resolver: Local Python + yt-dlp can resolve metadata and direct media URLs and expose JSON to a localhost PWA. This is a practical clean-room PoC, but it is a different stack from upstream Java NewPipeExtractor and inherits yt-dlp maintenance/YouTube breakage.
pwa_assessment.direct_media: Using the returned googlevideo URL as <audio>/<video> source avoids a stream proxy. The browser can request media cross-origin through a media element; JavaScript fetch/readback is subject to CORS and cannot be assumed. Validate supported codecs, range/seek behavior and browser playback per target browser.
pwa_assessment.url_lifetime_and_network_identity: Resolver output may be signed/expiring (often represented by an expire query parameter) and may depend on the network/IP context in which it was resolved. Re-resolve on expiry/failure. If resolver and browser have different egress IPs, or request moves to another network, direct playback can fail; avoid persisting resolved URLs as durable library data.
pwa_assessment.full_local_mode: LibreTube Full Local Mode is the end-user client calling YouTube directly; it does not mean the app embeds an HTTP media proxy. A localhost metadata resolver still makes upstream requests from its host, while playback is requested by the browser.
pwa_assessment.background_and_groups: PWA Media Session API can supply OS metadata/actions in supported browser contexts, but it is not an Android foreground service or app-owned MediaLibraryService and cannot promise persistent background playback. Native service/session requires a native wrapper or app. Channel filters/groups and subscriptions are feasible in PWA storage; NewPipe documents groups/feeds and LibreTube has Room-backed groups with channel-ID filtering.

licensing_boundary: Do not copy NewPipe, NewPipeExtractor, or LibreTube application code into BlackYT PoC. The research/src checkouts are for source inspection only; keep the PoC a clean-room implementation. GPL-3.0 applies to the inspected repositories.
